parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use the correct $\tan(A+B)$ formula and obtain an equation in $\tan\theta$ — M1, e.g. $(\tan\theta+\tan60^\circ)/(1-\tan\theta\tan60^\circ)=2/\tan\theta$.

Use $\tan60^\circ=\sqrt3$ and obtain a correct horizontal equation in any form — A1, e.g. $(\tan\theta+\sqrt3)\tan\theta=2(1-\sqrt3\tan\theta)$.

Reduce correctly to $\tan^2\theta+3\sqrt3\tan\theta-2=0$ — A1, AG.

Total [3].

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Solve the given quadratic to obtain a value for $\theta$ — M1; $\tan\theta=(-3\sqrt3\pm\sqrt{35})/2=0.3599\ldots,-5.556\ldots$.

Obtain one correct answer, e.g. $\theta=19.8^\circ$ — A1. Accept 1 d.p. or better; if over-specified it must be correct ($19.797\ldots^\circ$, $100.2029\ldots^\circ$).

Obtain the second correct answer $\theta=100.2^\circ$ and no others in the given interval — A1. Ignore answers outside the interval.

Total [3].
